name: Denji Sentai Megaranger
description: When his video game prowess is discovered by the International Network of Excel-Science and Technology — or I.N.E.T. — high school student Kenta Date is brought in to lend his expertise to their mysterious research. Meanwhile, four classmates show up, wanting to know more about the I.N.E.T. facility. Their experience will change their lives forever, as I.N.E.T. survives an attack by the nefarious Dr. Hinelar and an army from another dimension determined to conquer our reality! Now, it's up to Kenta and his four classmates to "install Megaranger" and become the team of heroes their video games prepared them to be!

Don't Let Them! The Twisted Invaders
videos.overview: Kenta Date, a game-playing high schooler, is recruited alongside four other students to unexpectedly become the Megaranger due to the pre-emptive start of an invasion from the dimension of Neziregia.

videos.title: Look! Our Galaxy Mega
videos.overview: After barely escaping from Neziregia to I.N.E.T.'s space headquarters, Kenta rashly returns to Earth to deal with them personally.

videos.title: For Real! A Huge Nejire Beast
videos.overview: Kenta confronts Shun about putting his needs over the team's when he chooses to do extra studies over his Megaranger duties.

videos.title: Smash it! Shibolena's Trap
videos.overview: Kouichirou discovers Shibolena performing infiltrations through the internet, forcing him in a situation where the other Megaranger may be rushing into combat without his help.

videos.title: Decide! This Is an Underhanded Battle
videos.overview: I.N.E.T. forces Professor Kubota to allow another scientist to use an auto-program on the Galaxy Mega as opposed to the Megaranger as Dr. Hinelar improves on the Nejire Beasts.

videos.title: We Did It! The Roaring Digitank
videos.overview: Miku is trapped within a Neziregia plot to destroy a high-tech building while being forced to date a boy who knows her secret.

videos.title: What the? The Annoying Stalker Girl
videos.overview: Chisato helps Kouichirou get a girl obsessed with him off his back as the Megaranger investigate a strange space lightning storm.

videos.title: Will We Lose!? Reverse Teamwork
videos.overview: Kenta is lured by Yugande into solo combat, putting the squad's teamwork at risk.

videos.title: Reveal! The Demon Lurking In CDs
videos.overview: Chisato becomes suspicious of Kenta's female friend when she starts stealing CDs connected with Nejiregia's latest plot.

videos.title: Goodbye! The Android of Sadness
videos.overview: Shun falls for a mysterious girl who is connected with a strange plot involving a beautiful woman causing havoc throughout the world.

videos.title: Danger! The Red Rose's Temptation
videos.overview: Chisato fights to protect a young girl from the grasp of a mysterious nun guiding children to a Nejiregia trap.

videos.title: Worry! We're Lazy Teachers
videos.overview: Kouichirou has problems with a lazy, uncouth teacher as they end up fighting to protect a meteorite from Nejiregia's grasp.

videos.title: Heartthrob! Our Teacher Is Like the Wind
videos.overview: Kenta falls for a new female substitute teacher whose past project is targeted for Neziregia's usage.

videos.title: Surprise! The Neighbors are Nejirejians
videos.overview: Miku tries to help out a cowardly boy when he starts seeing Kunekune move in to his apartment complex.

videos.title: See Through It! The Mecha of Genius High
videos.overview: Shun is called by a friend attending a gifted high school to investigate their digital research club, who are mysteriously building a weapon for Nejiregia.

videos.title: Very Bad! Will We Die?
videos.overview: A Nezire Beast infects the Megaranger with a deadly poison which gives them only 24 hours to live.

videos.title: Way Cool! The Sexy Super Miku
Protect it! The Mysterious Boy's Forest
videos.overview: As their vacation continues, Kouichirou encounters a boy tied to a forest he claims the Megaranger will destroy while fighting Nejiregia.

videos.title: Thrust! The Persistent Deadly Punch
videos.overview: Kenta loses confidence in his fighting abilities after he accidentally hits a child being used by Neziregia's newest commander.

videos.title: Count on it! The New Robo, Delta Mega
videos.overview: Kenta must bridge the differences between an I.N.E.T. engineer and his programmer father in order to gain the programming for the Megaranger's newest mech.

videos.title: Right Now! The Life-Threatening Super Combination
videos.overview: Guirail manipulates Kenta to summon Delta Mega so that Nejiregia can take control of it as their own weapon of destruction.

videos.title: Break Out! The Devilish Labyrinth
videos.overview: Shun and Miku become trapped within a labyrinth of dimensional doors in order to protect a crystal from a Nejire Beast that requires it.

videos.title: Why! My Egg's a Nejire Beast
videos.overview: Kenta discovers an egg accidentally left by Nejiregia that he hatches and raises into his new best friend.

videos.title: Running Alone! A Silvery New Face
videos.overview: After seemingly defeating a tough Nejire Beast, the Megaranger are pursued by a strange man who suspects a greater problem with their recent battle.

videos.title: Just in Time! Time Limit: 2.5 Minutes
videos.overview: Yusaku is punished by Kubota for stealing the MegaSilver prototype and abandoning his I.N.E.T. duties as the other Megaranger pursue a strange beach illness.

videos.title: Really? The End of Nejirejia
videos.overview: Kouichirou and Yusaku investigate an I.N.E.T. employee who claims to have invented a device that will stop Nejiregia.

videos.title: Kick Them About! The Demonic Coral That Calls Death
videos.overview: The Megaranger investigate an island where people are being abducted and changed into coral by a Nejire Beast.

videos.title: It's Over! The Explosive Granny Whirlwind
videos.overview: Chisato forces Kouichirou to play along in getting her grandmother off her back regarding getting an arranged marriage.

videos.title: I Wanna Lose Weight! Miku's Dubious Diet
videos.overview: Miku is tricked into partaking in a Nezire Beast's diet plan that may end up reducing the food supply instead of losing weight.

videos.title: Explosion! The Friendship Combination
videos.overview: Kenta and Shun's teamwork connection becomes endangered when Shun loses his memory against a desperate Guirail.

videos.title: Stop it! Guirail's Reckless Run
videos.overview: Dr. Hinelar gives Guirail a capsule to make him powerful enough to finally defeat the Megaranger, without revealing the horrifying cost of his new power.

videos.title: Is It the End!? Desperate Situation, Galaxy Mega
videos.overview: With Super Galaxy Mega being devastated by the mindless Mad Guirail, Kubota instructs the Megarangers to separate the formation and travel to the moon on the Delta Mega to gain the completed Space Mega Project from Hayakawa while they desperately try to hold off Mad Guirail on Earth with the Galaxy Mega.

videos.title: Cheerful! The Lover Who Came From the Moon
videos.overview: The female I.N.E.T. programmer behind Kenta's Battle Riser comes to Earth for a crucial upgrade, which MegaRed tries to believe is something more romantic.

videos.title: I'll Show You! Big Bro's Miracle Shoot
videos.overview: Kouichirou's problems in helping his little brother practice soccer lead his brother into becoming a minion in a Nejiregia plot.

videos.title: Overcome! Mega Silver's Greatest Crisis
videos.overview: Kenta and Miku try to please Hayakawa when they think he's going to die while a Psycho-Nejira tries to take advantage of MegaSilver's greatest weakness.

videos.title: Flap Your Wings! The Wings of Hope Dancing in the Sky
videos.overview: I.N.E.T. punishes Yusaku for his actions in becoming MegaSilver against their orders just as he prepares his last piece of the Space Mega Project to be revealed.

videos.title: Why? Chisato Has an Old Man's Voice
videos.overview: A jealous Psycho-Nejirar switches Chisato's voice with it's own just as she needs it for a singing competition.

videos.title: Scary! Nejirejia's Fiendish Squadron
videos.overview: When Dr. Hinelar releases an evil Sentai squadron which destroys the Megaranger, Kubota is forced to investigate their connection to Dr. Samejima, his former friend and partner.

videos.title: Exposed! Mega Red's True Identity
videos.overview: While keeping an eye on his identity out of fear of the Neziranger, Kenta is forced to serve a little girl who discovers that he is MegaRed.

videos.title: Scary! Bad Women
videos.overview: Chisato and Miku get into an argument over a trifle matter while NeziYellow and NeziPink challenge each other in finishing off their respective Megaranger.

videos.title: Collapsing! The Blue Terror, Neji Blue
videos.overview: Shun tries to figure a strategy for dealing with the Neziranger, leading to a unique plan to use their fanaticism against themselves.

videos.title: Lose Them! The Evil Stalkers
videos.overview: The Megarangers work to guide Miku away from the remaining Nezirangers, who are working together to track down and reveal their prey.

videos.title: We Won't Lose! The Decisive Battle is on Christmas Eve
videos.overview: The Megaranger track down the stolen Mega Voyager, leading to a climactic showdown with the Nejiranger... and unknowingly advancing Hinelar's ultimate desire!

videos.title: Relax! Kenta's New Year's Eve Riot
videos.overview: Kenta mysteriously loses his Digitizer while the rest of the Digital Research Club cleans up for New Years.

videos.title: Stubborn! Hinelar's Big Strike Back
videos.overview: As Kenta begins to worry about surviving his last exams, Dr. Hinelar uses Javious' remains to create a new city where he brings in humanity to serve him.

videos.title: Prevent it! Setting Sail to Underworld
videos.overview: The Megaranger try to foil a plot in people being manipulated to leave Japan for boats being redirected to Hinelar City.

videos.title: Plunge! The Dreadful Hinelar City
videos.overview: Kouichirou and Chisato must weigh whether to complete their university entrance exam or save their powerless friends when they become trapped in Hinelar City.

videos.title: Crush it! Hinelar's Dark Designs
videos.overview: The Megarangers stage a final assault on Hinelar City to save everyone abducted from Hinelar's ultimate plan, only to be pursued by the still vengeful Neziranger.

videos.title: Despair! We're Outcasts!?
videos.overview: Moroboshi High becomes exposed to attack when intentionally targeted by Hinelar for the Megaranger, leading to their expulsion.

videos.title: Sublime! The Red-Hot Super Soldier Yugande
videos.overview: As the Megaranger try to cope with their estranged status from society, Yugande convinces Shibolena to upgrade him for an all-out final attack.

videos.title: Seize it! Our Diplomas
videos.overview: As Dr. Hinelar launches a final assault on Earth, the Megaranger must stand up against Kubota's rival to face down their criticisms and finally complete their jobs as high school students.
